//: What checks the interface without changing the language it is written in.
Every function here says in its documentation comment what it takes and what
it answers with, and this is what reads those as types. Nothing is compiled:
noEmit, because what ships is built by esbuild out of the same sources.
strict, so a value with no type of its own is refused rather than read as
any. What the service answers is typed in interface/answers.d.ts, and the
kit is read out of interface/nextstep.js, which the interface imports, so
the kit is held to the same rules as everything that uses it.
The two ways around those rules are a type written as any and a comment
that tells the checker to look away. tests/test_types.py refuses both.
